entities.summary:
Prosper of Reggio was an Italian saint and bishop of Reggio Emilia from approximately 444 to 466 CE, serving under the Byzantine Empire. Little is known about his life, but documents confirm his twenty-two-year tenure as bishop. Prosper's significance lies in his role as a Christian leader during a tumultuous period in Italian history.

The exact dates of Prosper's birth and death are unknown, and only a few details about his life are recorded in historical accounts. Despite this scarcity of information, Prosper's legacy has endured, with his feast day still celebrated in the Catholic Church.

Prosper's legacy is also intertwined with the rise of Christianity in Italy during the 5th century. His actions as a bishop likely influenced the development of the faith in the region, although the specifics of his impact remain unclear.

One notable aspect of Prosper's life is the fact that he was a bishop during a time of significant cultural and political change in Italy. The Western Roman Empire was in decline, and the Byzantine Empire was exerting influence over the region. Prosper's tenure as bishop may have been influenced by these broader historical trends.
